alarm_response_text: VIB warn: VIB.DE.H.RMS >4.5 mm/s. Check AE and BPFO envelope. Capture burst spectrum. Plan roll-change if sustained >30 min.
consequence_if_missed: Continued operation may progress to spall alarm; 12 h planned vs 80k unplanned cost delta
notes: Deadband 0.3 prevents chattering at boundary; 5s delay filters process transients

alarm_response_text: VIB alarm: VIB.DE.H.RMS >7.1 mm/s. Initiate controlled stop per Playbook 01. LOTO. Do NOT emergency trip. Notify supervisor.
consequence_if_missed: Risk of bearing spall fragment; spall can contaminate rolling surface and cause strip defects
notes: No auto-return — operator acknowledgement required before restart

alarm_response_text: BPFO warn: envelope amplitude >1.0 g. Leading indicator of outer-race spall. Check AE trend. Accelerate planned roll-change.
consequence_if_missed: Outer-race fatigue degrading — unplanned bearing failure within days to weeks if not actioned
notes: 10s delay avoids transient load peaks on grade change

alarm_response_text: BPFO alarm >3.0 g. Stop rolling campaign at end of current coil. Controlled stop Playbook 01. Inspect bearing.
consequence_if_missed: Bearing failure imminent — continued operation risks roll damage and strip quality loss

alarm_response_text: TEMP warn: bearing outer ring >85 degC. Confirm lube supply. Check OFB outlet temp. Plan controlled stop if rising.
consequence_if_missed: Thermal degradation accelerates fatigue; risk of lube breakdown above 85 degC
notes: 30s delay avoids transients during roll bite load peaks

alarm_response_text: TEMP ALARM >100 degC. Controlled stop now (Zone D per ISO 20816). Do NOT emergency trip hot stand. Notify shift supervisor immediately.
consequence_if_missed: Lube film breakdown → bearing seizure → roll damage → strip cobble → safety hazard
rationalization_standard: ISO 15243:2017 sec7; safety P1 due to hot-metal environment

alarm_response_text: OFB outlet warn >75 degC. Check lube supply pressure and flow. Elevated outlet temp precedes inner race thermal overheat.
consequence_if_missed: OFB thermal runaway leads to oil-film breakdown; 60s delay filters transient thermal peaks during grade change
notes: 60s delay justified for slow thermal process

alarm_response_text: OFB outlet alarm >85 degC. Controlled stop. Investigate lube circuit. Do not restart without root cause identified.
consequence_if_missed: Oil film breakdown imminent — bearing damage within minutes if oil not restored

alarm_response_text: AE warn >6 dBuV. Earliest bearing defect indicator. Capture burst spectrum within 2 shifts. Begin planning roll-change.
consequence_if_missed: AE crosses warning 3-5 weeks before BPFO alarm — earliest actionable leading indicator; action here prevents P1 scenario
notes: 30s delay reduces nuisance alarms from mill vibration floor

alarm_response_text: AE alarm >12 dBuV. Multi-sensor confirmation required. If BPFO also elevated, invoke Playbook 01 controlled stop.
consequence_if_missed: Stage 3/4 bearing degradation if AE AND BPFO both alarming; single AE alarm may be noise
notes: Rationalized to require co-confirmation with BPFO — reduces false alarm rate from ~40% single-sensor

alarm_response_text: GMF warn >6.0 mm/s. Increase oil sampling to 5-day interval. Check Fe PPM. Schedule borescope within 72h if oil >20 ppm.
consequence_if_missed: Undetected gear-tooth crack propagation to Stage 2 risks catastrophic gear fracture and 168h+ downtime ($600k+)
notes: Warning is key decision gate for reduced-load protocol

alarm_response_text: GMF ALARM >10.0 mm/s. Immediate controlled stop. Crane extraction for borescope. Do NOT restart without specialist sign-off.
consequence_if_missed: Tooth fracture imminent — secondary shaft damage and catastrophic gearbox failure risk
notes: P1 due to high production loss and secondary hazard from flying gear fragments

alarm_response_text: Oil temp warn >80 degC. Check lube cooler. Reduce load if possible. If rising, controlled stop before alarm.
consequence_if_missed: Viscosity drop below VG220 minimum at high temp accelerates wear; 60s delay for slow thermal process

alarm_response_text: Oil temp alarm >90 degC. Controlled stop. Inspect cooler. Do not restart until temp <65 degC and root cause found.
consequence_if_missed: Oil oxidation and varnish formation at >90 degC irreversibly degrades oil quality

alarm_response_text: Oil pressure warn <2.2 bar. Check lube pump and filter DP. Gear surfaces lose lubrication below 2.2 bar.
consequence_if_missed: Low lube pressure starves gear mesh — accelerates wear and can initiate scuffing within minutes
notes: LOW direction alarm; deadband 0.1 bar avoids chattering on pump pulsation

alarm_response_text: Oil pressure ALARM <2.0 bar. Immediate stop — lube starvation risk. Investigate pump/filter before restart.
consequence_if_missed: Lube starvation → gear scuffing → failure within minutes; P1 for criticality-1 equipment

alarm_response_text: Fe PPM warn >15 ppm. Increase sampling to 5-day interval. Book spectrographic analysis. Watch GMF vib for corroboration.
consequence_if_missed: Fe rise precedes GMF vib rise by 1-2 weeks — early actionable leading indicator; rationalization: lab-measured

alarm_response_text: Fe PPM alarm >40 ppm. Immediate borescope. Do not defer. Risk of catastrophic tooth fracture.
consequence_if_missed: Alarm-level Fe indicates active metal removal — tooth fracture imminent

alarm_response_text: MCSA rotor bar sideband warn >-45 dBc. Confirm at steady load. Begin planning motor swap to insurance spare within 4 weeks.
consequence_if_missed: Broken rotor bar — multi-bar failure risk if unactioned; planned 10h swap vs extended production loss
notes: 60s delay as MCSA needs steady-state load to be meaningful; warn at -45 dBc (midpoint to alarm -35 dBc)

alarm_response_text: MCSA sideband ALARM >-35 dBc. Plan motor swap within 2-4 weeks. Send failed motor for rotor-bar test. Verify phase rotation on spare.
consequence_if_missed: Progressive bar cracking — risk of rotor imbalance and winding damage if allowed to run to failure

alarm_response_text: Winding temp warn >145 degC (Class F limit 155 degC). Reduce load or improve cooling. Check VFD for overfluxing.
consequence_if_missed: Insulation degradation accelerates above 145 degC; each 10 degC over limit halves insulation life

alarm_response_text: Winding temp ALARM >155 degC. Immediate trip. Do not restart until temp <100 degC and insulation test passed.
consequence_if_missed: Winding burn at >155 degC; Class F absolute maximum; fire and total motor loss risk
notes: P1 due to fire risk and MV safety

alarm_response_text: Current imbalance warn >2%. Check VFD output phase balance. Sustained imbalance increases HF bearing current risk.
consequence_if_missed: Imbalance drives HF currents that cause EDM bearing pitting (per FSB-ABB-2024-003)
notes: 30s delay avoids nuisance on dynamic load changes

alarm_response_text: Current imbalance ALARM >5%. Stop motor. Investigate VFD + supply. Risk of thermal damage and rotor heating.
consequence_if_missed: Severe unbalance causes negative-sequence rotor currents — heating and winding stress

alarm_response_text: Motor body VIB warn >4.5 mm/s. Check shaft alignment. May indicate rotor eccentricity or bearing degradation.
consequence_if_missed: Early bearing fault or eccentricity — requires spectrum analysis to differentiate

alarm_response_text: Motor VIB ALARM >7.1 mm/s. Stop motor. Inspect bearings and alignment.
consequence_if_missed: High vibration risks winding insulation mechanical stress and bearing damage

alarm_response_text: 2×50Hz VIB warn >1.0 mm/s. Indicates developing rotor eccentricity. Schedule air-gap measurement survey within 2 weeks.
consequence_if_missed: Eccentricity leads to uneven magnetic pull; if progressing to 2.5 alarm

alarm_response_text: 2×50Hz VIB ALARM >2.5 mm/s. Significant eccentricity. Stop motor for air-gap measurement and rotor inspection.
consequence_if_missed: Rotor-stator rub risk at >2.5 mm/s; catastrophic motor failure

alarm_response_text: Suction press warn <90 kPa. Check suction strainer. Risk of NPSH reduction and cavitation onset.
consequence_if_missed: Cavitation onset degrades impeller and mechanical seal — accelerates to alarm failure mode within hours to days
notes: LOW direction; 5s delay avoids transient on valve operations

alarm_response_text: Suction press ALARM <70 kPa. Immediate controlled stop. Investigate suction blockage before restart.
consequence_if_missed: Severe cavitation at <70 kPa — rapid impeller erosion and possible liquid-metal steam flash in HP service
notes: P1 because HP descale pump failure causes mill delay and safety hazard

alarm_response_text: Discharge press warn <175 bar. Check impeller condition. May indicate impeller erosion.
consequence_if_missed: Reduced descale pressure inadequate for oxide scale removal — strip surface defects accumulate

alarm_response_text: Discharge press ALARM <165 bar. Inadequate descale. Stop and inspect pump.
consequence_if_missed: Strip surface oxide not removed — downstream rolling quality failure

alarm_response_text: AE warn >8 dB. Possible cavitation onset (100-500 kHz band). Confirm suction pressure. Reduce flow if required.
consequence_if_missed: AE is leading indicator for cavitation — acts before visible impeller damage; 10s delay filters transient hits

alarm_response_text: AE alarm >15 dB. Severe cavitation or impeller damage. Stop pump and inspect.
consequence_if_missed: Active cavitation damage accelerates exponentially once alarm crossed

alarm_response_text: Casing VIB warn >2.5 mm/s. Check mechanical seal condition (seal failure signature). Switch to standby if weeping observed.
consequence_if_missed: Seal degradation — escalates to seal blowout if not actioned

alarm_response_text: Casing VIB ALARM >5.0 mm/s. Seal failure likely. Switch to standby. LOTO for seal change.
consequence_if_missed: Seal blowout at 200 bar service — high-pressure water hazard; seal change mandatory

alarm_response_text: Bearing temp warn >85 degC. Check lubrication. Seal friction may be elevating bearing temp.
consequence_if_missed: Bearing degradation approaching — combined VIB + temp pattern is SCN-040 signature

alarm_response_text: Bearing temp ALARM >100 degC. Stop pump. Inspect bearing and seal.
consequence_if_missed: Bearing seizure imminent above 100 degC

alarm_response_text: BLW 1X VIB warn >4.5 mm/s. Check for deposit imbalance. Check bearing temps and shaft displacement.
consequence_if_missed: Turbo-blower vibration escalation can progress to surge or bearing failure; $500k/hr BF downtime
notes: P2 (not P3) because BF blower is criticality-1

alarm_response_text: BLW 1X VIB ALARM >7.1 mm/s. Immediate trip. Check for surge. Borescope IGVs/impellers.
consequence_if_missed: Catastrophic BF blower failure risk; BF downtime $500k/hr

alarm_response_text: Shaft displacement warn >80 µm pk-pk. Approaching API 670 alert. Check bearing condition. Notify BF engineer.
consequence_if_missed: Journal bearing degradation or rotor instability — escalates rapidly in turbo-blower
notes: 2s delay per API 670 dynamic protection rationale

alarm_response_text: Shaft displacement ALARM >127 µm. API 670 trip. Immediate trip. Do NOT restart until cause identified and repaired.
consequence_if_missed: Rotor-bearing contact imminent; catastrophic failure and BF shutdown

alarm_response_text: Bearing temp warn >80 degC. Check lube oil pressure and supply. Investigate thrust bearing independently.
consequence_if_missed: BF blower bearing overheating precedes journal bearing failure; review lube circuit immediately

alarm_response_text: Bearing temp ALARM >95 degC. Immediate trip. Investigate lube and thrust bearing before restart.
consequence_if_missed: Babbitt melt risk above 95 degC; journal bearing failure → shaft contact → catastrophic

alarm_response_text: Surge warn >5% oscillation. Verify ASV is open. Monitor shaft displacement and shaft 1X. Notify BF process engineer.
consequence_if_missed: Surge onset — can escalate to destructive surge in seconds; ASV must respond within 2s
notes: 2s delay; P2 at warn due to rapid escalation risk

alarm_response_text: SURGE ALARM >8%. Trip machine immediately if ASV not stopping oscillation. Do NOT restart until cause identified.
consequence_if_missed: Destructive surge seconds away; BF blower total loss and BF shutdown $4-8M event

alarm_response_text: Thrust bearing temp warn >90 degC. Investigate lube supply pressure. Check thrust bearing condition.
consequence_if_missed: Thrust bearing Babbitt melt at elevated temp; FSB-SIEMENS-MAN-2024-015 requires immediate lube investigation above 80 degC trending

alarm_response_text: Thrust temp ALARM >105 degC. Immediate trip. Babbitt melt risk. Do not restart.
consequence_if_missed: Thrust bearing failure → rotor axial displacement → rub → total machine loss

alarm_response_text: Segment force warn >480 kN. Check roll rotation speed. Possible roll dragging or roll seizure onset.
consequence_if_missed: Rising force with low RPM indicates roll seizure — risk of transverse slab crack and breakout
notes: 10s delay avoids process transients during casting speed change

alarm_response_text: Segment force ALARM >550 kN. Reduce casting speed. Confirm roll rotation. If RPM = 0, end heat, cool strand 2-4h.
consequence_if_missed: Roll seizure confirmed — transverse cracks and breakout risk; safety hazard (liquid core exposure)

alarm_response_text: Roll RPM warn <1.0 rpm. Possible bearing drag or seizure onset. Cross-check with force sensor.
consequence_if_missed: Early roll seizure — if not actioned
rationalization_standard: force will spike and strand may crack
column20: LOW direction alarm; 5s delay avoids encoder noise

alarm_response_text: Roll RPM = 0. Seized roll confirmed. Immediate casting speed reduction. End heat. Cool strand. Evacuate personnel from caster bay.
consequence_if_missed: Seized roll drags strand — breakout hazard; liquid steel fatality risk
notes: 0 deadband — exact 0 is seizure confirmation; P1 safety

alarm_response_text: Bulge warn >2.0 mm. Check clamping force and segment gap setting. Possible segment misalignment.
consequence_if_missed: Bulge indicates insufficient secondary cooling or segment misalignment — shell thinning and breakout risk

alarm_response_text: Bulge ALARM >4.0 mm. End heat immediately. Shell breach risk.
consequence_if_missed: Shell failure and molten steel release — personnel safety

alarm_response_text: Spray flow warn <150 L/min. Check nozzle blockage or header pressure. Reduced cooling increases bulge risk.
consequence_if_missed: Insufficient secondary cooling causes shell thinning; multiple blocked nozzles not visible on zone sensor until 3+ blocked
notes: LOW direction; 10s delay for process transients

alarm_response_text: Spray flow ALARM <120 L/min. Severely inadequate secondary cooling. Reduce casting speed immediately. End heat if not recovering.
consequence_if_missed: Shell cooling failure — breakout risk

alarm_response_text: Roll bearing VIB warn >3.5 mm/s. Inspect segment at next heat break. Possible bearing fatigue onset.
consequence_if_missed: Roll bearing degradation — precursor to seizure (SCN-042); catch early for planned change

alarm_response_text: Roll bearing VIB ALARM >6.0 mm/s. End heat. Segment pull and bearing replacement.
consequence_if_missed: Imminent roll bearing failure

alarm_response_text: TC delta warn >25 degC. Monitor for V-pattern propagation. Check friction and level simultaneously for BPS confirmation.
consequence_if_missed: Possible shell sticking onset — single sensor FAR ~40%; requires 3-sensor confirmation per FSB-SMSCONCAST-2024-009
notes: 0s delay — sub-100ms BPS response required; warn is advisory pending co-confirmation

alarm_response_text: TC delta ALARM >50 degC with V-pattern. BPS confirmed breakout. Reduce speed to 0.5 m/min immediately. If all 3 sensors alarm: emergency stop + close tundish gate. Evacuate caster floor.
consequence_if_missed: Breakout — liquid steel floor escape; fatality risk; $200k-$3M event per FSB

alarm_response_text: Friction warn >10 kN. Check SEN condition. Reduce casting speed if combined with TC delta warn. Review mould taper.
consequence_if_missed: High friction indicates shell/mould sticking — BPS precursor
notes: 5s delay for process transient during casting speed change

alarm_response_text: Friction ALARM >18 kN. BPS active breakout alert. Co-confirm with TC delta and level. Emergency protocol.
consequence_if_missed: Shell sticking confirmed — breakout imminent; same protocol as TC_DELTA alarm

alarm_response_text: Level deviation warn >5 mm. Check SEN flow and stopper rod response. Level instability is BPS co-confirming signal.
consequence_if_missed: Level oscillations cause surface defects and reinforce breakout precursor pattern

alarm_response_text: Level ALARM >12 mm. Emergency stop. Possible SEN failure or stopper rod failure. Evacuate caster floor.
consequence_if_missed: SEN failure → uncontrolled steel flow → overflow or breakout; fatality risk
notes: P1; 1s delay for sensor noise floor

alarm_response_text: Heat flux warn <1.0 MW/m2. Shell too thin — check SEN blockage, speed, and TC array uniformity.
consequence_if_missed: Low heat flux indicates poor shell formation — breakout risk if combined with casting speed above minimum
notes: LOW direction; 30s delay as computed parameter (slow response); lower is worse

alarm_response_text: Heat flux ALARM <0.8 MW/m2. Severe shell formation failure. Reduce speed immediately. End heat if not recovering.
consequence_if_missed: Shell so thin that breakout highly probable within minutes
notes: P1; 10s delay for computed parameter lag

alarm_response_text: Force ripple warn >4%. Periodic pattern at 1× roll rotation may indicate work-roll spall. Plan roll-change at end of current campaign.
consequence_if_missed: Roll spall printing defects on strip — unplanned roll change cost 16× planned
notes: 5s delay filters mill bite entry transients

alarm_response_text: Force ripple ALARM >8%. Stop rolling this coil. Segregate strip from warning onset. Quick-change work rolls.
consequence_if_missed: Spall fragment risk to strip surface and downstream equipment

alarm_response_text: Chock chatter warn >4.0 mm/s. Possible 5th-octave chatter or roll spall. Check force ripple for correlation.
consequence_if_missed: 5th-octave chatter causes periodic strip thickness variation — quality defect and roll wear
notes: 2s delay for mill chatter — fast phenomenon

alarm_response_text: Chock chatter ALARM >10.0 mm/s. Stop rolling immediately. Chatter at this level risks roll fracture.
consequence_if_missed: Severe chatter can fracture work rolls — catastrophic safety event in HSM

alarm_response_text: Crown deviation warn >25 µm. Check roll wear, thermal camber, and AGC. Strip flatness at risk.
consequence_if_missed: Crown deviation beyond ±25 µm produces off-spec strip crown — customer quality defect

alarm_response_text: Crown deviation ALARM >40 µm. Change rolls. Off-spec strip production — segregate.
consequence_if_missed: Strip crown out of tolerance — likely 100% product rejection above 40 µm for standard grades

alarm_response_text: Roll journal AE warn >8 dB. Possible journal or bearing defect. Cross-check with force ripple.
consequence_if_missed: Early roll journal degradation — catch before force ripple alarm

alarm_response_text: Roll journal AE ALARM >15 dB. Stop rolling. Inspect rolls and journals.
consequence_if_missed: Severe journal/bearing damage risk

alarm_response_text: Motor current warn >105%FLA. Check for belt blockage or idler seizure. Reduce feed if possible.
consequence_if_missed: Overload = blocked chute or seized idler — if not actioned

alarm_response_text: Motor current ALARM >125%FLA. Trip conveyor. Investigate blockage before restart.
consequence_if_missed: Motor thermal damage and belt damage if sustained overload

alarm_response_text: Idler US warn >8 dBuV above baseline. Identify idler position. Schedule replacement within 2 weeks or next patrol.
consequence_if_missed: Early idler bearing fault — catches 3-5 days before thermal rise; prevents belt-fire initiation
notes: 0s delay — patrol measurement; action required within inspection cycle

alarm_response_text: Idler US alarm >15 dBuV. Immediate IR scan. If temp >80 degC: stop belt and replace idler — fire risk.
consequence_if_missed: Seized idler under loaded belt is #1 belt-fire initiator; fire risk = P1 safety
notes: P1 due to belt-fire fatality risk

alarm_response_text: Idler temp warn >80 degC on IR scan. Stop belt on next available safe window and replace idler.
consequence_if_missed: Idler approaching seizure — belt fire risk within hours to days

alarm_response_text: Idler temp ALARM >100 degC. STOP BELT IMMEDIATELY. Fire imminent. LOTO. Replace idler before restart.
consequence_if_missed: Belt fire — catastrophic loss of conveyor and possible personnel injury

alarm_response_text: Belt edge warn >25 mm offset. Adjust training idlers within 1 shift. Prevents edge damage and rip initiation.
consequence_if_missed: Edge wear leads to carcass delamination and accelerates rip propagation
notes: 30s delay avoids nuisance on material surges

alarm_response_text: Belt edge ALARM >50 mm. Stop belt. Belt may contact structure. Risk of rip initiation.
consequence_if_missed: Edge damage and rip — extended downtime and belt replacement cost ($18k belt section + $600 vulcanise kit)

alarm_response_text: Rip loop current warn <48 mA. Possible partial loop damage. Conduct belt walk-down within 1 shift.
consequence_if_missed: Partial rip may be propagating — if not actioned escalates to full rip
notes: LOW direction; 5s delay for circuit noise

alarm_response_text: Rip loop ALARM = 0 mA. STOP BELT IMMEDIATELY. Longitudinal rip propagating. LOTO. Walk belt before restart.
consequence_if_missed: Active belt rip — total belt loss ($18k/section + 4-12h downtime) and material spillage hazard
notes: 0s delay; 0 mA = open circuit = confirmed rip; P1

alarm_response_text: Shell IR warn >180 degC. Refractory thickness <50% remaining. Schedule gunite repair in next planned cool. Derate to 65%.
consequence_if_missed: Refractory burnout — shell perforation and hot gas release if not repaired within 14 days
notes: 0s delay — IR patrol; warn triggers mandatory repair scheduling

alarm_response_text: Shell IR ALARM >250 degC. Immediate furnace derate to 50% and schedule emergency cool within 24h. Risk of shell perforation and fire.
consequence_if_missed: Shell breach — furnace fire and safety hazard; P1 safety

alarm_response_text: Flame signal warn <70%. Check gas pressure and burner nozzle. Risk of unstable combustion. Purge before re-light if needed.
consequence_if_missed: Unstable flame → unburnt fuel accumulation → explosion risk if reignited; EN 746-2
notes: LOW direction; 5s delay for transient gas pressure dips

alarm_response_text: Flame ALARM <40%. Automatic fuel cutoff. Purge furnace before re-light. Do NOT attempt re-light without supervisor sign-off.
consequence_if_missed: Flame-out with unburnt fuel in furnace — explosion hazard; EN 746-2 mandatory auto-cutoff

alarm_response_text: Flue O2 high warn >5.0%. Excess air — energy waste and possible flame instability. Re-tune fuel/air ratio.
consequence_if_missed: Excess air reduces thermal efficiency and can mask underlying combustion issues

alarm_response_text: Flue O2 alarm >6.0%. Significant excess air. Check burner controls. Reduce firing to 80% until re-tuned.
consequence_if_missed: Excess air causes fuel waste and uneven heating; potential strip quality impact

alarm_response_text: Flue O2 LOW warn <1.0%. Oxygen-deficient combustion. Risk of CO accumulation. Check burner and gas supply.
consequence_if_missed: CO accumulation — poisoning risk and explosion hazard; EN 746-2 safety interlock zone

alarm_response_text: Zone temp warn >1300 degC. Risk of slab overheating and refractory hot face damage. Reduce setpoint.
consequence_if_missed: Slab overheating causes scale growth and hot shortness; above 1330 refractory sinter damage

alarm_response_text: Zone temp ALARM >1330 degC. Reduce firing immediately. Risk of refractory damage and slab overheating above solidus.
consequence_if_missed: Refractory damage and potential slab liquation above solidus; P1 for furnace integrity
rationalization_standard: Type S TC specification; refractory practice

alarm_response_text: HPU oil temp warn >60 degC. Check cooler function. Reduce duty cycle if possible.
consequence_if_missed: Viscosity drop accelerates wear; above 60 degC in EAF service accelerates oxidation and varnish

alarm_response_text: HPU oil temp ALARM >70 degC. Investigate cooler. Stop HPU if no cooling recovery.
consequence_if_missed: Oil degradation and servo damage above 70 degC

alarm_response_text: Filter DP warn >3.0 bar. Plan filter change FLT-HYD-10 within 4 hours. Stock check.
consequence_if_missed: Clogged filter reduces flow and bypasses on some designs — bypassed dirt reaches servo circuit

alarm_response_text: Filter DP ALARM >4.5 bar. Immediate filter change regardless of operating state.
consequence_if_missed: Bypass opens above 4.5 bar — dirty oil direct to servo circuit

alarm_response_text: Water content warn >200 ppm. Defer new heat. Connect coalescer filter. Investigate water ingress source.
consequence_if_missed: Water above 200 ppm causes emulsification and micro-pitting; EAF electrode cooling leak most likely source

alarm_response_text: Water ALARM >500 ppm. Hydraulic oil emulsified. Stop HPU immediately. Do not operate until oil is replaced.
consequence_if_missed: Emulsified oil loses lubricity — servo and pump failures risk electrode crash into melt; safety

alarm_response_text: BF CW pump 1X VIB warn >2.8 mm/s. Check bearing and impeller. Schedule hydraulic test.
consequence_if_missed: BF cooling pump failure risks BF tuyere/stave cooling — possible BF campaign loss

alarm_response_text: BF CW pump VIB ALARM >5.6 mm/s. Switch to standby. Investigate bearing and impeller.
consequence_if_missed: BF cooling loss = BF safety hazard; P1
notes: P1 due to BF cooling criticality

alarm_response_text: Head deviation warn <-7%. Impeller wear progressing. Plan impeller replacement at next planned outage.
consequence_if_missed: Head loss reduces BF cooling margin; -7% = 2.5× impeller wear rate; action before alarm
notes: LOW direction; 60s delay for slow hydraulic process

alarm_response_text: Head deviation ALARM <-12%. Switch to standby pump. Impeller replacement mandatory before return to service.
consequence_if_missed: Severely degraded cooling flow — BF stave cooling at risk

alarm_response_text: BF CW pump bearing temp warn >85 degC. Check lubrication. Plan replacement.
consequence_if_missed: Bearing failure could stop BF cooling — P2 for BF criticality

alarm_response_text: BF CW pump bearing ALARM >100 degC. Immediate switch to standby. Bearing failure risk.
consequence_if_missed: BF cooling failure safety event

alarm_response_text: Sinter fan 1X VIB warn >4.5 mm/s. Schedule online balancing if deposit imbalance suspected. Check axial ratio.
consequence_if_missed: Sinter plant stoppage impacts BF burden; P2 for sinter criticality

alarm_response_text: Sinter fan 1X VIB ALARM >7.1 mm/s. Immediate trip. Inspect for blade damage.
consequence_if_missed: Fan blade failure risk; P1

alarm_response_text: Sinter fan bearing temp warn >80 degC. Check grease — dust ingress common. Re-grease with high-temp EP.
consequence_if_missed: Bearing lube degradation from dust ingress; early action prevents seizure

alarm_response_text: Sinter fan bearing ALARM >95 degC. Trip fan. Replace bearing during outage.
consequence_if_missed: Bearing seizure — fan loss and sinter plant stoppage

alarm_response_text: Sinter fan axial ratio warn >0.4. May indicate shaft bow or blade distortion. Check for asymmetric deposit vs structural issue.
consequence_if_missed: Axial ratio rise is NOT correctable by balancing alone if structural — schedule offline inspection

alarm_response_text: Sinter fan axial ratio ALARM >0.7. Plan offline inspection within 2 weeks. Possible shaft bow or blade crack.
consequence_if_missed: Structural damage risk; fan cannot be balanced-out above alarm

alarm_response_text: Sinter fan duct DP warn >18 kPa. Possible downstream blockage or deposit restricting duct. Investigate.
consequence_if_missed: Increased duct resistance degrades fan performance and sinter quality

alarm_response_text: Sinter fan duct DP ALARM >22 kPa. Significant flow restriction. Check ductwork and cyclone.
consequence_if_missed: Severe restriction risks fan surge and production loss

alarm_response_text: Rope MFL warn >150 mV (~8-12% LMA). Competent Person inspection required BEFORE next molten-metal lift. Restrict to dry loads >150 mV without CP sign-off.
consequence_if_missed: Wire rope approaching discard criteria — ladle drop risk; P1 safety-critical (molten metal)
notes: 0s delay — patrol measurement; P1 because molten-metal service; no auto-return even at warn

alarm_response_text: Rope MFL ALARM >300 mV (>15-20% LMA or >=12 random broken wires). Take crane OOS immediately. Do not lift. Call specialist.
consequence_if_missed: ISO 4309:2017 mandatory discard — ladle drop catastrophic (Qinghe benchmark $1M-$20M); P1

alarm_response_text: Load warn >95% SWL. Near limit for molten-metal ladle service. Operator attention — do not add to load.
consequence_if_missed: Ladle crane molten-metal service has stricter SWL limits; 95% WLL is alarm for this crane class

alarm_response_text: Load ALARM >110% SWL. Power cut to hoist. Do NOT override. Investigate overload cause before restart.
consequence_if_missed: Overload above 110% SWL risks rope failure and ladle drop; auto power cut mandatory

alarm_response_text: Hoist gearbox GMF warn >1.0 g. In molten-metal service apply 20% conservative threshold. Plan gearbox inspection.
consequence_if_missed: Gearbox failure could cause uncontrolled load descent — molten ladle drop; FSB-KONECRANES-2024-006 action at 0.8g
notes: P2 for crane gearbox in molten-metal service

alarm_response_text: Hoist gearbox GMF ALARM >2.5 g. Crane OOS. Gearbox inspection mandatory before next lift.
consequence_if_missed: Gearbox failure risk with molten ladle — P1

alarm_response_text: Brake drum warn >110 degC. Allow cool-down before next lift. Inspect brake pads monthly.
consequence_if_missed: Overheated brakes lose holding torque — risk of load descent; FSB-KONECRANES-2024-006

alarm_response_text: Brake ALARM >120 degC. Do NOT lift. Lower load under control. Brake inspection mandatory.
consequence_if_missed: Brake fade at >120 degC — uncontrolled load descent with molten ladle; P1

alarm_response_text: Servo position error warn >1.5%. Possible silt on spool. Switch AGC to backup mode if >3 excursions per 4h.
consequence_if_missed: AGC loss → gauge excursion → strip rejection; CRM ~INR 2.1M/cobble-hour
notes: 5s delay to distinguish process-load hunting from silt

alarm_response_text: Servo position error ALARM >3.0%. Switch AGC to manual lock. LOTO servo circuit. Bench-clean or replace valve.
consequence_if_missed: AGC loss causes uncontrolled gauge variation → cobble → mill stop; P1 for cold-rolling

alarm_response_text: Gauge deviation warn >10 µm. Check AGC position error. Investigate servo or roll wear contribution.
consequence_if_missed: Strip out-of-spec — customer quality issue and possible rejection

alarm_response_text: Gauge deviation ALARM >20 µm. Stop rolling. Segregate strip from warning onset. Investigate servo + rolls.
consequence_if_missed: Strip above ±20 µm 100% rejected for most grades; production loss and scrap cost
